payload.text: ADR-0007 (one clean unversioned contract — engine hot-upgrade handoff, ENCODE side; the inverse of dec_cut). `enc_cut(v: Cut) -> u8` is the pure, total encoder of the expiry-Cut discriminant into the single handoff byte image: NewYork1000->0, Tokyo1500->1, with no wildcard arm, so adding a Cut variant is a compile-time break rather than a silent mis-encode. It reads only its `Cut` argument and writes nothing (pure: no side effects, no allocation). Because there is exactly ONE current contract (guardrail 9: no schema_version, no N/N-1 negotiation), enc_cut/dec_cut are a fixed mutually-inverse codec pair consumed by serialize_state/restore_state — a hot-upgrade deploys a single uniform version with no mixed-version window, so the byte mapping needs no version tag. This is the decision/trade-off: a tagless 1-byte discriminant (cheapest, deterministic) is sound precisely because the unversioned-contract rule removes any back-compat obligation.
